ABSTRACT
Campus Fix is a web-based Smart Campus Complaint and 
Suggestion
Management System designed to provide a structured channel for students to
report campus-related issues and communicate with the administration. In a
college environment, problems involving classroom equipment, 
electrical
facilities, water supply, sanitation and general maintenance are 
often
communicated through informal methods. These methods may not provide a
centralised record or a convenient way for students to follow the progress of a
reported issue. Campus Fix provides a central platform where students can
register, log in, submit complaints or suggestions and track the status of their
reports. Each report contains relevant information such as type, category, title,
location, priority and description. Administrators can view submitted reports,
review the details, update the report status and provide an administrative
response. The application contains two main dashboards: the Student Dashboard
and the Admin Dashboard. Analytics are included within the Admin Dashboard.
The frontend is developed using HTML5, CSS3 and vanilla Java Script. Java
Spring Boot implements backend REST AP Is and application logic, while
MySQL is used for persistent storage.This report presents the 
problem
background, literature review, research gap, scope, system design, modules,
workflow, frontend and backend implementation, sample code, testing approach,
conclusion and future enhancements. Campus Fix aims to improve 
the
organisation, visibility and traceability of campus issue reporting.
